Peak Form Climbing About us Schedule & rates

Schedule and rates

Hours are the same every day of the week because we tried closing a day and everyone just showed up anyway.

  • Monday–Thursday: 10am–10pm
  • Friday: 10am–11pm
  • Saturday–Sunday: 9am–9pm

New routes go up every Tuesday before open, usually six to eight of them. The setting crew is on the wall from 7am; the doors stay locked and the coffee machine stays off until 10.

Rates

  • Day pass: $16 ($12 after 7pm weeknights)
  • 10-visit punch card: $135, good for a year
  • Monthly membership: $58, no sign-up fee, cancel any time in person
  • Junior (under 18) punch card: $90 for 10 visits

We take cash, cards, and the occasional IOU if you are a regular and we trust you with the ladder. Memberships do not auto-renew; you come to the desk when your month is up, same as every other paperwork we do.

Youth hour

Saturday mornings, 9–11am, the bouldering room is open to climbers under 14 at half the normal day-pass price. Two staff members are on the floor the whole time, and the mats get checked again beforehand. No experience needed, and parents can watch from the bench by the door for free.
